title: Neural Viscosity: Simulating High-Shear Emulsions Without Physical Homogenizers
excerpt: Analyzing the microscopic suspension of oils and botanical reductions in generative commercial video to eliminate dairy and lipid separation issues on camera.
content:
On conventional commercial culinary sets, sauces and emulsions have an unforgiving operational half-life. Hollandaise breaks under hot HMI lighting; vinaigrettes separate within forty seconds; foam collapses into dull froth.

Latent Hydrodynamics

Generative fluid modeling allows us to arrest and sculpt shear forces at will. We can choreograph the exact meniscus curvature of a velvety reduction cascading over a micro-seared scallop, preserving gloss, thickness, and kinetic tension across endless non-destructive takes.

This eliminates the constant culinary prep re-makes and food-stylist emergencies that historically inflated production budgets by thirty to fifty percent.
